## `add_motion_warping_component`

Attach a UMotionWarpingComponent to an actor in the editor world. Idempotent: if the actor already has one, returns the existing instance with already_existed:true instead of creating a duplicate. The component is NewObject&lt;UMotionWarpingComponent>(Actor, FName("MotionWarping")) followed by RegisterComponent() so it shows up in GetComponents() immediately. The owning world's level is marked dirty so the editor persists the change on save; no explicit SavePackage call (avoids the noise of saving a transient actor out of an editor world).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_path` | string | yes | Full editor path (e.g. "/Game/Maps/Test.Test:PersistentLevel.ActorName") or short name of the actor. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_path: string, component_path: string, already_existed: bool }`

## `add_pose_search_roled_skeleton`

Append a roled FPoseSearchRoledSkeleton (Skeleton + optional MirrorDataTable under a Role) to a UPoseSearchSchema for multi-character search. Idempotent on role: if an entry already exists under that role it no-ops (added=false, already_existed=true) instead of pushing a duplicate -- use set_pose_search_schema_skeleton if you actually want to REPLACE the skeleton bound to a role.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `asset_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the target UPoseSearchSchema (required). |
| `skeleton_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the USkeleton to bind under the role (required). |
| `role` | string | yes | Role name (FName) identifying the entry within a multi-character schema (required; empty = default/None role). |
| `mirror_data_table_path` | string | no | Asset path of a UMirrorDataTable to bind under the role (optional; empty = none). |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path, role, skeleton_path, mirror_data_table_path, roled_skeleton_count, added, already_existed, saved }`

## `add_warp_target_to_component`

Add (or update in-place) a FMotionWarpingTarget on an existing UMotionWarpingComponent. Exactly one of three payload shapes must be supplied: (1) component_path -> AddOrUpdateWarpTargetFromComponent(name, comp, NAME_None, false, TargetsForwardVector, ZeroVector, ZeroRotator); (2) location + rotation -> AddOrUpdateWarpTargetFromLocationAndRotation; (3) location only -> AddOrUpdateWarpTargetFromLocation. The engine API is idempotent by WarpTargetName (replace-in-place). Marking the owning actor dirty so the editor persists the change.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_path` | string | yes | Full editor path or short name of the actor. |
| `target_name` | string | yes | FName identifier for the warp target. |
| `location` | array | no | Optional world [x, y, z] location for the target. |
| `rotation` | array | no | Optional world [pitch, yaw, roll] rotation in degrees for the target. |
| `component_path` | string | no | Optional name of a USceneComponent on the actor to drive the target transform. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_path: string, target_name: string, warp_target_count: int, source: string, already_existed: bool }`

**Returns:** `{ skeletal_mesh_path: string, old_lod_count: int, new_lod_count: int, lod_count: int, baked: bool, regenerate_even_if_imported: bool, generate_base_lod: bool, bake_warning: string }`

## `build_animation_state_machine`

Atomic JSON-spec builder for an Animation Blueprint state machine. Builds (or reuses) the state machine, then iterates states, transitions, and per-transition rules in one idempotent call. Replaces 8+ primitive cmds (add_anim_state_machine + add_anim_state + add_anim_transition + set_anim_transition_rule_*) with a single spec. Re-running with the same spec is a no-op (each primitive is internally idempotent: state-by-name, transition-by-source+target). For repeated invocations that change rule shape, the rule is re-applied on the existing transition.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anim_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Path to the UAnimBlueprint asset |
| `state_machine_name` | string | yes | Target state machine name (created if missing via add_anim_state_machine) |
| `spec` | object | yes | JSON describing the graph shape. states: [{name: str, animation?: str (/Game/Anim/Foo — optional; load-bearing for the runtime state asset but NOT created here), loop?: bool, pos?: [x, y]}]. transitions: [{from: str, to: str, blend?: number (= crossfade_duration seconds), bidirectional?: bool, priority_order?: int, rule?: object}]. Each rule variant maps 1:1 to an existing primitive cmd: {type: "automatic", enabled?: bool = false, trigger_time?: number = 0.0} \| {type: "bool", variable: str (must exist on the AnimBP), invert?: bool = false} \| {type: "comparison", variable: str (must be float/double on the AnimBP), operator: "=="\|"!="\|">"\|"&lt;"\|">="\|"&lt;=", comparison_value: number}. An absent rule leaves the transition inert (no rule wired). |
| `compile_after` | boolean | no | Optional, default false; if true runs compile_anim_blueprint at the end |

**Returns:** `{ success: bool, anim_blueprint_path: string, machine_name: string, machine_already_existed: bool, states_created: int, states_skipped: int, transitions_created: int, transitions_updated: int, transitions_skipped: int, errors: [string], compiled: bool, compiled_after: bool }`

**Returns:** `{ database_path, schema_path, schema_cardinality, animation_asset_count, wait_for_completion, result, success, in_progress, failed, message }`

## `connect_anim_graph_pins`

Wire two AnimGraph pins (pose links AND data pins) using the graph's OWN schema. USE THIS INSTEAD OF connect_pins inside an AnimGraph: the generic connect_pins uses the K2 schema, which does not understand FPoseLink/FComponentSpacePoseLink pose pins, whereas this goes through UAnimationGraphSchema::TryCreateConnection so pose links connect correctly. Saves the ABP but does NOT recompile it -- run compile_anim_blueprint after your edits for runtime effect.

| `anim_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Path/name of the UAnimBlueprint. |

| `target_node_id` | string | yes | NodeGuid of the target node. |
| `target_pin` | string | yes | Input pin name on the target node. |
| `graph_name` | string | no | Target graph (optional, default the top-level AnimGraph). |

**Returns:** `{ connected, source_node_id, target_node_id, saved }`

## `connect_ik_goal_to_solver`

Connect an existing IK Rig goal to a solver, creating that solver's per-goal effector/settings.  This is the step that makes get_/set_ik_goal_settings work: a goal added via add_ik_goal is not attached to any solver until connected. Idempotent — re-connecting an already-connected goal is a no-op (already_connected:true), avoiding the duplicate the raw engine call would create.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ik_rig_path` | string | yes | Content path to the IK Rig asset. |
| `goal_name` | string | yes | Name of an existing goal (created via add_ik_goal). |
| `solver_index` | number | yes | Index of the solver in the rig's solver stack. |

**Returns:** `{ ik_rig_path: string, goal_name: string, solver_index: int, connected: bool, already_connected: bool, saved: bool }`

## `copy_anim_graph_nodes`

Copy a set of AnimGraph nodes (with internal FAnimNode settings + intra-selection wiring) between graphs. Equivalent to the editor's copy/paste: preserves each node's runtime struct properties and any links WITHIN the copied set (links to nodes outside the selection are dropped). Saves the destination ABP but does NOT recompile it -- run compile_anim_blueprint after your edits for runtime effect.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src_anim_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Source UAnimBlueprint path/name. |
| `node_ids` | array | yes | Array of source NodeGuid strings (from get_graph_nodes) to copy. |
| `dst_anim_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Destination UAnimBlueprint path/name. |
| `src_graph` | string | no | Source graph name (optional, default the top-level AnimGraph). |
| `dst_graph` | string | no | Destination graph name (optional, default the top-level AnimGraph). |
| `offset_x` | number | no | X offset added to every pasted node (optional, default 0). |
| `offset_y` | number | no | Y offset added to every pasted node (optional, default 0). |

**Returns:** `{ copied_count, id_map:{old->new}, imported_nodes[], missing_node_ids[], saved }`

## `evaluate_pose_search_query`

Run a live motion-matching query on a PIE/Game actor against a loaded UPoseSearchDatabase (UPoseSearchLibrary::MotionMatch) and return the best-match asset + search cost, plus the query trajectory. Diagnoses why a chooser returns null. Best-effort: per-channel cost is not exposed by the BlueprintPure result.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `database_path` | string | yes | UPoseSearchDatabase asset path to search (required). |
| `world` | string | no | Which world to resolve: absent (default) = prefer the live PIE/Game world \| 'server' (the PIE world with authority) \| 'client' \| 'pie:N' \| 'pie'/'game' force the live session (errors if none running) \| 'editor' forces the editor world. |
| `actor_name` | string | no | Actor name or label whose AnimInstance drives the query. Omitted = the first player controller's pawn. |
| `pose_history_name` | string | no | Tag of the PoseSearchHistoryCollector anim-graph node used to build the query (default 'PoseHistory'). |
| `max_trajectory_samples` | number | no | Cap on emitted query trajectory samples (&lt;=0 = all; default 0). |

**Returns:** `{ world_mode, actor_name, actor_resolved, anim_instance_class, pose_history_name, pose_history_found, database_path, query_trajectory_samples[], trajectory_sample_count, is_trajectory_empty, has_match, best_match_asset, best_match_database, best_cost, selected_time, is_continuing_pose_search, wanted_play_rate, is_mirrored, is_looping, per_channel_cost[], note, world_name, world_package, world_type, net_mode, pie_instance }`

## `get_ik_bone_settings`

Get bone-specific settings for a bone within a solver.  FullBodyIK returns snake_case keys (rotation/position stiffness, axis limits Free/Limited/Locked, min/max angles, preferred angles); StretchLimb (the only other solver with per-bone settings) is serialized generically (camelCase: squashDirection vector). Only FullBodyIK and StretchLimb support per-bone settings; others return a `note`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ik_rig_path` | string | yes | Content path to the IK Rig asset. |
| `solver_index` | number | yes | Index of the solver. |
| `bone_name` | string | yes | Name of the bone to query settings for. |

**Returns:** `{ ik_rig_path: string, solver_index: int, bone_name: string, settings: object }`

## `get_ik_goal_settings`

Get goal-specific settings for a goal connected to a solver.  FullBodyIK returns snake_case keys (chain_depth, strength_alpha, pull_chain_alpha, pin_rotation); BodyMover (the only other solver with per-goal settings) is serialized generically (camelCase: influenceMultiplier, boneName). The goal must be connected to the solver first (connect_ik_goal_to_solver), else a `note` explains that. Solvers without per-goal settings return a `note`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ik_rig_path` | string | yes | Content path to the IK Rig asset. |
| `solver_index` | number | yes | Index of the solver. |
| `goal_name` | string | yes | Name of the goal to query settings for. |

**Returns:** `{ ik_rig_path: string, solver_index: int, goal_name: string, settings: object }`

## `get_pose_search_runtime_state`

Read-only report of the live motion-matching state on a PIE/Game actor (why a chooser returns null): its AnimInstance, its MotionTrajectory samples, whether a PoseSearchHistoryCollector node named pose_history_name exists, and (optionally) the target database's schema/channels.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `world` | string | no | Which world to resolve: absent (default) = prefer the live PIE/Game world, else the editor world \| 'server' (the PIE world with authority -- what a server-driven character lives in) \| 'client' \| 'pie:N' \| 'pie'/'game' force the live session (errors if none running) \| 'editor' forces the editor world. |
| `actor_name` | string | no | Actor name or label to inspect. Omitted = the first player controller's pawn (the locally-controlled character). |

## `scale_anim_curve`

Retime a FLOAT curve on a UAnimSequence: every key TIME becomes (t - origin) * factor + origin, and the key VALUES are left untouched -- this stretches/compresses a curve in time, it does not scale its amplitude. FLOAT-CURVE ONLY: transform curves and any other non-float curve return applied=false instead of an error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anim_sequence_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the UAnimSequence. |
| `curve_name` | string | yes | Name of the float curve. |
| `factor` | number | no | Scale factor applied to each key TIME (default 1.0). |
| `origin` | number | no | Time origin the key times are scaled about (default 0.0). |

**Returns:** `{ anim_sequence_path, curve_name, origin, factor, num_keys, applied, saved, message }`

## `set_anim_graph_node_pin_binding`

Bind an AnimGraph node's input pin (property) to a variable/property path via UAnimGraphNode_Base property bindings (the detail-panel "bind" chip). set_anim_graph_node_property writes the internal FAnimNode struct; this writes the pin BINDING map instead -- e.g. bind a Pose History node's "TransformTrajectory" pin to a "Trajectory" variable. Saves the ABP but does NOT recompile it -- run compile_anim_blueprint after your edits for runtime effect.

| `anim_blueprint_path` | string | no | Path or name of the UAnimBlueprint (aliases: anim_blueprint, blueprint_name). |
| `graph_name` | string | no | Target graph (optional; deep-resolved; default the top-level AnimGraph). |
| `anim_blueprint` | string | no |   |
| `blueprint_name` | string | no |   |

**Returns:** `{ node_id, pin_name, binding_path, applied, binding:{property_name, property_path[], path_as_text, is_bound, is_promotion, binding_type, pin_category}, saved }`

## `set_anim_graph_node_property`

Write a property of an AnimGraphNode's internal FAnimNode struct by (dotted) name. Saves the ABP but does NOT recompile it -- run compile_anim_blueprint after your edits for runtime effect.

|---|---|---|---|
| `anim_blueprint_path` | string | yes | Path/name of the UAnimBlueprint. |
| `node_id` | string | yes | NodeGuid of the target AnimGraphNode. |
| `property` | string | yes | Property path inside the FAnimNode (e.g. "PoseCount", "SlotName"). A leading "Node." is tolerated. Nested structs use dots ("A.B"). |

| `value_json` | any | no | JSON value applied via JsonValueToUProperty. Use for complex/nested types. Takes precedence over value. |
| `graph_name` | string | no | Target graph (optional, default the top-level AnimGraph). |

**Returns:** `{ node_id, property, applied, new_value, saved }`

## `set_ik_bone_settings`

Set bone-specific settings for a bone within a solver.  Partial update (idempotent): only fields present in ``settings`` are applied; bone settings are auto-created if absent. FullBodyIK snake_case keys: rotation_stiffness (0-1), position_stiffness (0-1), limit_x/limit_y/limit_z ("Free"/"Limited"/"Locked"), min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y, min_z, max_z, use_preferred_angles (bool), preferred_x, preferred_y, preferred_z. StretchLimb uses its live bone struct's camelCase keys (squashDirection: {x,y,z}). Only FullBodyIK and StretchLimb support per-bone settings; others return an honest error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ik_rig_path` | string | yes | Content path to the IK Rig asset. |
| `solver_index` | number | yes | Index of the solver. |
| `bone_name` | string | yes | Name of the bone to modify. |
| `settings` | object | yes | Object with bone-specific fields to set. |

## `set_ik_goal_settings`

Set goal-specific settings for a goal connected to a solver.  Partial update (idempotent): only fields present in ``settings`` are applied. FullBodyIK uses snake_case keys: bone_name, chain_depth (0+), strength_alpha (0-1), pull_chain_alpha (0-1), pin_rotation (0-1). BodyMover uses its live goal struct's camelCase keys (influenceMultiplier 0-10, clamped server-side). Connect the goal first with connect_ik_goal_to_solver. Solvers without per-goal settings return an honest error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ik_rig_path` | string | yes | Content path to the IK Rig asset. |
| `solver_index` | number | yes | Index of the solver. |
| `goal_name` | string | yes | Name of the goal to modify. |
| `settings` | object | yes | Object with goal-specific fields to set. |

**Returns:** `{ ik_rig_path: string, solver_index: int, goal_name: string, success: bool }`

Set the start and/or end bone for a solver in an IK Rig.

## `set_ik_solver_settings`

Set detailed solver-specific settings on a solver in an IK Rig.  Partial update: only fields present in ``settings`` are applied (idempotent). FullBodyIK uses snake_case keys: root_bone, iterations (0-1000), sub_iterations (0-1000), mass_multiplier (0-10), allow_stretch (bool), root_behavior (enum string), global_pull_chain_alpha (0-1), max_angle (0-45), over_relaxation (1-2). Other solver types (Limb/Pole/BodyMover/SetTransform/StretchLimb) accept the camelCase names of their live settings struct; ClampMin/ClampMax bounds are enforced server-side.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ik_rig_path` | string | yes | Content path to the IK Rig asset. |
| `solver_index` | number | yes | Index of the solver in the rig's solver stack. |
| `settings` | object | yes | Object with solver-type-specific fields to set. |

**Returns:** `{ ik_rig_path: string, solver_index: int, solver_type: string, success: bool }`

## `set_pose_search_schema_properties`

Author UPoseSearchSchema scalar tunables via reflection (partial merge + clamp). Replaces the 8 former per-field set_pose_search_schema_* setters.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `asset_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the target UPoseSearchSchema (required). |
| `properties` | object | yes | Object of UPoseSearchSchema UPROPERTY fields to merge; keys are the C++ property NAMES (case-insensitive), absent keys untouched. Covers: SampleRate(int, ClampMin=1 ClampMax=240), bAddDataPadding(bool), bInjectAdditionalDebugChannels(bool), bDrawInjectAdditionalDebugChannels(bool), NumberOfPermutations(int, ClampMin=1), PermutationsSampleRate(int, ClampMin=1 ClampMax=240), PermutationsTimeOffset(float), DataPreprocessor(enum name: None/Normalize/NormalizeOnlyByDeviation/NormalizeWithCommonSchema). Object-refs (skeleton, mirror_data_table) and the role tag are set via their dedicated commands, not here. |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path, asset_class, settings, applied_keys, changed, saved }`

| `skeleton_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the USkeleton to bind under the given role (required). |

Edit an existing Control Rig control's shape/gizmo/color/limit-draw settings (the bits add_rig_control can't set afterwards).  Read-modify-write: reads the control's FRigControlSettings, applies the provided fields, writes back via URigHierarchyController::SetControlSettings, recompiles + saves, and returns the verified read-back. Only the supplied fields change.

This positions the manipulator gizmo relative to the control, independent of the control's value.

|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset |
| `lod_index` | number | no | LOD index to modify (default 0) |
| `recompute_normals` | boolean | no | bool, recompute normals |
| `recompute_tangents` | boolean | no | bool, recompute tangents |
| `use_mikk_t_space` | boolean | no | bool, use Mikk T space |
| `compute_weighted_normals` | boolean | no | bool, compute weighted normals |
| `remove_degenerates` | boolean | no | bool, remove degenerate triangles |
| `high_precision_tangents` | boolean | no | bool, use high precision tangent basis |
| `high_precision_weights` | boolean | no | bool, use high precision skin weights |
| `full_precision_uvs` | boolean | no | bool, use full precision UVs |
| `bone_influence_limit` | number | no | int, max bones influencing each vertex |

**Returns:** `{ lod_index: int, settings_applied: {...}, saved: bool }`

## `set_skeletal_mesh_lod_reduction_settings`

Author a LOD's FSkeletalMeshOptimizationSettings (ReductionSettings) — the data bake_skeletal_mesh_lod consumes, making the bake steerable instead of running with defaults.  Partial update (idempotent): only fields present are written. Enums are by name (full "SMTC_NumOfTriangles" or short "NumOfTriangles"). termination_criterion (SMTC_*) and reduction_method (SMOT_*) are DISTINCT.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset. |
| `lod_index` | number | no | LOD index to modify (default 0). |
| `termination_criterion` | string | no | SMTC_*: NumOfTriangles\|NumOfVerts\|TriangleOrVert\|AbsNumOfTriangles\|AbsNumOfVerts\|AbsTriangleOrVert. |
| `reduction_method` | string | no | SMOT_*: NumOfTriangles\|MaxDeviation\|TriangleOrDeviation. |
| `num_of_triangles_percentage` | number | no | float ratio of triangles to retain (0.1 = 10%). |
| `num_of_vert_percentage` | number | no | float ratio of vertices to retain. |
| `max_deviation_percentage` | number | no | float [0,1], accuracy target when reduction_method=MaxDeviation. |
| `max_num_of_triangles` | number | no | int absolute triangle cap (ClampMin 4). |
| `max_num_of_verts` | number | no | int absolute vertex cap (ClampMin 6). |
| `max_num_of_triangles_percentage` | number | no | int (editor-only) cap when using percentage criterion (ClampMin 4). |
| `max_num_of_verts_percentage` | number | no | int (editor-only) cap when using percentage criterion (ClampMin 6). |
| `base_lod` | number | no | int base LOD index to generate from (default 0). |
| `silhouette_importance` | string | no | SMOI_*: Off\|Lowest\|Low\|Normal\|High\|Highest. |
| `texture_importance` | string | no | SMOI_* importance of texture density. |
| `shading_importance` | string | no | SMOI_* importance of shading quality. |
| `skinning_importance` | string | no | SMOI_* importance of skinning quality. |
| `max_bones_per_vertex` | number | no | int max bone influences per vertex (ClampMin 1). |
| `welding_threshold` | number | no | float vertex weld distance. |
| `normals_threshold` | number | no | float hard-edge angle in degrees (used when recalc_normals). |
| `recalc_normals` | boolean | no | bool recompute normals. |
| `remap_morph_targets` | boolean | no | bool remap morph targets onto the reduced LOD. |
| `enforce_bone_boundaries` | boolean | no | bool penalize collapses across different major bones. |

**Returns:** `{ lod_index: int, settings_applied: {...}, saved: bool }`

## `set_skeletal_mesh_lod_screen_size`

Set per-LOD ScreenSize.Default on a skeletal mesh.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset |
| `lod_index` | number | yes | LOD index to modify |
| `screen_size` | number | no | New ScreenSize.Default value |

**Returns:** `{ skeletal_mesh_path: string, lod_index: int, old_screen_size: float, screen_size: float, applied: bool }`

## `set_skeletal_mesh_lod_settings`

Set the remaining flat per-LOD scalars/enums of FSkeletalMeshLODInfo that no other setter covers (hysteresis, CPU access, morph error tolerance, skin cache usage, mesh deformer, prioritization weight).  Partial update (idempotent): only fields present are written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset. |
| `lod_index` | number | no | LOD index to modify (default 0). |
| `lod_hysteresis` | number | no | float, avoids flickering at the LOD boundary. |
| `allow_cpu_access` | boolean | no | bool, keep this LOD's data on the CPU (e.g. for FX sampling). |
| `morph_target_position_error_tolerance` | number | no | float in microns, Clamp 0.01..10000 (default 20). |
| `skin_cache_usage` | string | no | ESkinCacheUsage by NAME: Auto\|Disabled\|Enabled (Disabled=255, parsed by name). |
| `allow_mesh_deformer` | boolean | no | bool, whether a Mesh Deformer is used on this LOD. |
| `weight_of_prioritization` | number | no | float >=0, weight given to BonesToPrioritize/SectionsToPrioritize. |

**Returns:** `{ lod_index: int, settings_applied: {...}, saved: bool }`

## `set_skeletal_mesh_material_slot`

Assign a material to an existing material slot of a skeletal mesh ASSET (writes FSkeletalMaterial.MaterialInterface in USkeletalMesh::GetMaterials()). Address the slot by slot_index OR slot_name (exactly one). Never auto-grows the slot array.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the USkeletalMesh asset. |
| `material_path` | string | yes | Content path to the UMaterialInterface to assign. |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Zero-based index of an existing material slot (mutually exclusive with slot_name). |
| `slot_name` | string | no | Name of an existing material slot to resolve to its index (mutually exclusive with slot_index). |

**Returns:** `{ skeletal_mesh_path: string, slot_index: int, slot_name: string, material_path: string, saved: bool }`

## `set_skeletal_mesh_min_lod`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset |
| `min_lod` | number | no | New MinLodIdx (must be in [0, NumLODs-1]) |

**Returns:** `{ skeletal_mesh_path: string, old_min_lod: int, min_lod: int, lod_count: int, applied: bool }`

## `set_skeletal_mesh_socket_parent`

Re-parent an existing socket on a skeletal mesh to a different bone. Validates the bone exists in the reference skeleton.

| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset |
| `socket_name` | string | yes | Name of the socket to re-parent |

## `set_skeletal_mesh_socket_transform`

Set the local transform (relative to parent bone) of a socket on a skeletal mesh. All three of location/rotation/scale are optional; only fields present are written.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skeletal_mesh_path` | string | yes | Content path to the skeletal mesh asset |
| `socket_name` | string | yes | Name of the socket to modify |
| `location` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] relative location |
| `rotation` | array | no | Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] relative rotation (degrees) |
| `scale` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] relative scale |

**Returns:** `{ socket_name: string, skeletal_mesh_path: string, applied: {location, rotation, scale}, location_x: float, location_y: float, location_z: float, rotation_pitch: float, rotation_yaw: float, rotation_roll: float, scale_x: float, scale_y: float, scale_z: float }`

Stop animation montage playback on a skeletal mesh component

## `wire_aim_offset`

Create a UBlendSpace1D asset for aim-offset blending (yaw or pitch axis). Idempotent on re-run.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `package_path` | string | yes | UE content folder. |
| `asset_name` | string | yes | BlendSpace1D asset name. |
| `skeleton_path` | string | yes | Path to the target USkeleton. |
| `axis_name` | string | no | Optional axis name (default "Yaw"). |
| `min_value` | number | no | Optional float (default -90.0). Axis minimum. |
| `max_value` | number | no | Optional float (default 90.0). Axis maximum. |
| `num_grid_points` | number | no | Optional int (default 4). |

**Returns:** `{ asset_path, axis_name, min_value, max_value, num_grid_points, already_existed, saved }`
